description.value: Walmart Supercenter (Store 5853) in Surrey South is a large-format retail store offering groceries alongside electronics, clothing, toys, furniture, and more. As a supercenter format, it is a practical one-stop resupply point for touring cyclists needing to restock food, household supplies, or gear. The store is wheelchair accessible and includes public washrooms.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (7 spaces) at 95m. Total: 7 spaces.
